claim: The person stated on 2026-10-15 that both off readings of PFS Status taken on 2026-10-13, 0000000000000000 and 0000000100000000, are focus hold off, and that the codes differ because one was taken out of range and the other in range.

valid_until.event: the stand's firmware or the Micro-Manager NikonTi2 adapter changes, which can change what these properties report. The readings themselves are bounded to 2026-10-13 in their text.

validity_conditions: THE PERSON'S READING OF THE READINGS, kept separate from pfs_reports_focus_maintenance_status_and_range_in_three_states so that what was read and what it means are not one claim. It agrees with the record's own PFS in Range column: 'Out of Range' with Status 0000000000000000 and 'In Range' with 0000000100000000. What it says: whether the stand is in range shows in the Status code apart from engagement. What it does NOT say: which bit of Status means engaged, or what the searching state reads, which was not caught. E5 because it is a statement made two days after the bench, not a reading. Which reading the envelope uses as not engaged is the person's and is written in envelope/safety.json; this entry does not judge it, and is not a command or a limit.
